# BASICGOL

> BASICGOL is an educational programming language with Portuguese keywords, combining BASIC and Portugol readability with C11. Its documentation site contains guides, a code-derived reference, tests, examples, and project history, mainly in Brazilian Portuguese.

BASICGOL programs are C files using a macro layer and library; they run as native C programs, without a virtual machine or interpreter. The optional `basicgolc` transpiler handles syntax that cannot be expressed by macros alone. Generated reference pages reflect source code and tests; hand-written guides and historical reports provide context. Check the compatibility matrix before claiming support for a compiler or platform: executed, compiled, evaluated, and untested are distinct states.

## Documentation

- [Documentation home](https://pato.is-a.dev/BASICGOL/): Overview of the site and its documentation sections.
- [Getting started](https://pato.is-a.dev/BASICGOL/guias/comecar/): Prerequisites, build commands, and a first program.
- [Getting started source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/havaianasdestruido/BASICGOL/main/website/manuais/comecar.mdx): Text version of the guide.
- [Language reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/havaianasdestruido/BASICGOL/main/docs/02-referencia.md): Keywords and language reference in Markdown.
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/havaianasdestruido/BASICGOL/main/docs/api-reference.md): Public headers and linking information.
- [Generated reference](https://pato.is-a.dev/BASICGOL/referencia/): Code-derived pages for macros and library functions, with contracts and test evidence.
- [Examples](https://github.com/havaianasdestruido/BASICGOL/tree/main/docs/exemplos): Example programs and expected outputs.
- [Compatibility matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/havaianasdestruido/BASICGOL/main/docs/11-matriz-compatibilidade.md): Evidence and limitations for compilers and platforms.
- [Tests](https://pato.is-a.dev/BASICGOL/testes/): Documentation of test cases and their evidence.
